meta.title: Task board
meta.description: A four-column board in the sidebar: to do, running, review, done. The new-card entry is available both at the top right and at the bottom of the To do column, and the drawer auto-saves (1.2s after you stop typing, every 8s while typing, and once more before closing), so clicking away never loses content. Park as many ideas as you like in To do — text, images, attachments, and a target workspace — and press Run only when you are ready. Run creates a conversation in that workspace, sends the card as its first message (your title becomes the first line, the body follows verbatim; leave the title blank and only the body is sent, with the first line used just for the card and conversation name), and starts immediately; the card moves to Running with a live timer. When the turn finishes it lands in Review: open the card to reach the ordinary conversation page, and if you keep talking there the card returns to Running, then back to Review. Mark it Done when you are satisfied, and undo that if you change your mind. Cards never move by hand — status follows the conversation itself. Board data lives on this machine at $DSH_HOME/dsh-kanban-fx/board.json and stays on disk after the plugin is removed.
